info.title: Popssibilities - Proposed API Contract
info.description: Week 4 shared contract aligned to the October 5 reference review. Only the shared /live and /health routes are implemented. Business endpoints remain proposals owned by assigned developers. All examples are synthetic and numeric totals are not real pricing. React/Vite, Flask and MySQL scaffolding was approved by Isaac; AWS research and full-payment replacement were not adopted.

servers.description: Local shared shell URL; only /live and /health currently implemented.

post.description: Validate event and catering details; return server-owned pricing or requires_review with null pricing. No final pricing tier, heart price, delivery formula, service fee, or dry-ice allocation is established. Quantity must be at least 50. Technical limits and 15-minute expiry are proposed. Never accept client totals. Recorded Q&A identifies Wingman Kitchens Houston at 4783 Lexington Blvd, Missouri City, TX as origin; postal code and distance method remain open. Beyond 30 miles return requires_review/null pricing with next_action contact_inquiry. Do not silently calculate a normal delivery fee or submit an out-of-area order.

patch.description: Compare version atomically before changing data. Customer/event/catering objects replace their complete object, not a recursive partial merge. Event or catering changes require a matching new priced quote and quote_id. For already confirmed deposits, return 409 until the client approves a price-adjustment policy (D09). Preserve previous pricing in audit history. No status/deposit updates through this route.

Confirmed deposit evidence stays in the private audit record.
